notes: Engine screens: 12 (1 crashed in evaluate, logged). Daily/minute pre-checks logged as looks: 56. KEY FINDING: the classic NIFTY 'overnight drift' (spot close->next open +11 pts/night 2012-20, +20 pts 2021-24, 9/9 years; intraday -7) is mostly NOT tradable on futures. Minute decomposition 2021-24: spot 09:15 open sits ~10 pts above the 09:16 open (stale pre-open print), and futures lose ~8 pts/night of carry (basis decay, incl. weekends). Futures 15:20->09:16 earn only +4.0 pts/night gross vs ~6.5 pts round-trip cost; futures intraday 09:20->15:20 is +0.35 pts (the spot 'intraday drag' is basis, not behaviour). Engine: unconditional long overnight futures 2021-24 = -47k (09:20 exit) / -97k (09:16), PF 0.94-0.97. So daily-candle overnight pre-checks overstate futures by ~0.09% of the index per night; I corrected for that. Trend/VIX conditioning (SMA50/200, trend votes, VIX percentile, RSI) does not help on futures 2021-24 (all-4-trend-votes nights were the WORST, +1.5 pts gross). What survives: overnight CONTINUATION of the day's move. 2012-20 spot long-up/short-down spread +2.7 pts/night (t 2.27, 7/9 yrs); with 3 agreeing votes (close>prev close, close>open, close in upper half of range) +3.15 (t 2.25, 8/9). 2021-24 futures spread ~10 pts/night (4/4 yrs). The short side after down days is weak after costs and ex-top-5% fails (L/S 3-vote: +250k but net_ex_top_k -166k), so only the long side is submitted. Candidate is MARGINAL: long history after artifact+carry correction is +2.5 pts/trade net, t 1.24, 7/9 years; 2023 ~flat; at 2x slippage 2023 is slightly negative. Regime gates did not help (trend!=down gate: +84k, t 1.27): in training a big share came from down/volatile regime 6 rebounds (2022), which the 2012-20 history does NOT support (regime 5/6 negative there), so the playbook should treat regime 6 profits as suspect. Exit 09:20 beat 09:16 in both long variants (+257k vs +210k for this rule; first minute is noisy) - I chose 09:20 after seeing both, a small selection.
platform_issues: evaluate() crashes with KeyError when a trade_day isn't in trading_days(): trading_days reads DISTINCT dates from spot_1m, but NIFTY spot_1m is missing 2022-03-29 in the snapshot while fut_1m has 752 rows, so a futures trade exists that day; by_day.loc[d] adds the label and the drawdown-recovery pd.Index(days).get_loc(hit.index[0]) raises. Repro: screen(on long futures prev_day 15:20 entry with filter chg_pct(15m)>0 & chg_pct open>0 & price>vwap, costs.fut_slippage_points=2) 2021-01-01..2024-12-31. Workaround in my scratch: wrap evaluate so trading_days includes trade days. Also: spot_1m has a gap on 2022-03-29 (data).

validate_spec still warns 'No target, stop or signal exit' for intraday / prev_day specs that have exits.underlying_stop (the check only counts underlying_stop when swing), although engine 6 supports intraday underlying stops.

Daily-candle overnight pre-checks (open[t+1]-close[t]) are biased for futures by ~10 pts (stale 09:15 spot open) + ~8 pts carry per night at 2021-24 levels; the brief's suggested pre-check should subtract ~0.09% of the index per night or use 09:16 minute data.
With prev_day time entries the daily filter reads the day before the entry day (latest closed daily candle at 15:20), so regime gates lag one extra day; fine but worth documenting.

candidates.name: NIFTY fut overnight long after a strong day (3 votes) 15:20->09:20
candidates.hypothesis: When NIFTY closes the session strong (above previous close, above today's open, above VWAP at 15:15), the move continues overnight; buy 1 lot near-month future at 15:20, sell next day at 09:20.
candidates.mechanism: Late-day buying pressure / information that isn't fully priced by the close (order-flow continuation, global session follow-through, institutions finishing allocations). Holding only the overnight leg harvests the positive overnight component conditional on strength while avoiding the intraday leg, and the 3-vote agreement filters marginal up days.
candidates.failure_modes: Futures carry (~8 pts/night) and costs (~6.5 pts round trip) eat most of the drift; edge per trade is small (~8-12 pts gross) so a regime where overnight gaps turn negative (e.g. weak global cues, 2023) or higher slippage wipes it out. Fat-tailed: a few gap nights dominate (2021-24 net_ex_top_k +51k only). Long-history support after correction is weak (t 1.24). Concentration in down/volatile rebound nights in 2022.
